winchester.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Winchester

The Theatre Royal Winchester on Jewry Street carries drama, dance, comedy and music through the year, while Winchester Cathedral hosts concerts and recitals under its great nave. Hat Fair, the UK's longest-running festival of street theatre, fills the city streets and Abbey Gardens each July, and Boomtown brings a vast five-day production to the Matterley Estate on the downs nearby.

And the trade runs at every size across Hampshire. Past the cathedral-city headline, Winchester's grassroots scene runs through the Railway Inn and its compact stages of original live music, while the Hat Fair fills the city centre and North Walls each July as one of the country's longest-running outdoor arts festivals. Neighbouring Eastleigh and the wider Test and Itchen valleys add their own halls and open-air dates, so a crew based here covers street-arts staging and intimate rooms alike.
